Part of the position is commonly taken off at 1R and the rest runs with the stop at entry. Here too the model does not make money by itself. The choice of days and discipline decide.
Short je zrcadlo longu: sweep nad high,: The short is the mirror of the long: a sweep above the high, MSS down, FVG in premium, stop above the wick, target at the low.
Short hledej jen tehdy, když vyšší timef: Look for a short only when the higher timeframe is heading down.
Cíl je konkrétní likvidita pod cenou, ne: The target is specific liquidity below price, not an arbitrary number of points.
Kde leží FVG pro short vstup?: Where does the FVG for a short entry lie?
V premiu, v horní polovině pohybu: In premium, in the upper half of the move
Prodává se draho. Mezera pro short má bý: You sell expensive. The gap for a short should be above the middle of the move.
Obchodní den futures začíná v 18:00 newy: The futures trading day starts at 18:00 New York time. The Asian session runs overnight. Volume is usually low and price builds a narrow range. Mark its high and low; stops rest above and below them.
Mezi 2:00 a 5:00 se přidává Londýn. Čast: Between 2:00 and 5:00 London joins in. It often takes one side of the Asian range. Here it ran above the Asian high, closed back below it and turned down.
V 9:30 otevírá akciový trh v New Yorku a: At 9:30 the New York stock market opens and the day's biggest volume arrives. The first move is often a trap. Here price took the London low and the candle closed back above it.
Hlavní okno pro intradenní obchod je v T: In Tape the main window for an intraday trade is 9:30 to 11:00 New York time. After liquidity is taken, this is where the day's move most often gets going. Big moves start mainly around 8:30 and 9:30.
Kolem poledne objem padá a cena se často: Around noon volume drops and price often just drifts. The afternoon can move again, but most of the work is usually done in the morning. Do not trade outside your window just because you are sitting at the chart.
Seance a čas: kdy se trh hýbe: Sessions and time: when the market moves
Stejný setup má jinou váhu ve tři ráno a: The same setup carries different weight at 3 a.m. and at 9:30. Before you look for an entry, you need to know which part of the day is running.
Nejdřív čas, potom cena. Asie staví rozp: Time first, then price. Asia builds the range, London and New York take liquidity from it.
Okno 9:30–11:00 není signál. Bez sweepu: The 9:30–11:00 window is not a signal. Without a sweep and a structure shift there is nothing to trade in it.
Časy jsou newyorské. Na jaře a na podzim: The times are New York times. In spring and autumn Europe and the US differ in daylight saving for a few weeks, and the gap to Prague is an hour smaller.
Je 12:30 newyorského času a cena se půl: It is 12:30 New York time and price has drifted in a narrow band for half an hour. What is the sensible thing to do?
Počkat, kolem poledne bývá objem nízký: Wait, volume is usually low around noon
Zvětšit pozici, průraz přijde každou chv: Size up, the breakout is coming any moment
Obchodovat každý dotek hrany pásma: Trade every touch of the band's edge
Kolem oběda objem klesá a pohyby se čast: Volume drops around lunch and moves often do not follow through. Waiting is not a mistake.
Začni na denním grafu. Každá svíčka je j: Start on the daily chart. Each candle is one day. Price makes higher highs and higher lows, so the big picture points up. The last two days are just a correction.
Označ high a low včerejšího dne. Říká se: Mark yesterday's high and low. They are called PDH and PDL. Above PDH rest the sellers' stops, below PDL the buyers' stops. They are the first two levels the market cares about today.
Vyber cíl dne, draw on liquidity. Ptej s: Pick the day's target, the draw on liquidity. Ask which liquidity lies in the direction of the big picture and is closest. Here it is PDH and, right above it, the old high at 112.
pod PDL plán padá: below PDL the plan is off
Urči, co plán ruší. Kdyby cena zavřela p: Decide what cancels the plan. If price closed below yesterday's low, the upward direction no longer holds and you do not look for a long today. This level is written in advance, not once it hurts.
Všechno zapiš do plánu dne v Tape: směr,: Write it all into the daily plan in Tape: direction, target, invalidation and the session you want to trade. In the evening compare the plan with what the market did. Today price reached PDH and the old high.
Ranní příprava: směr a cíl dne: Morning preparation: direction and the day's target
Příprava zabere deset minut a probíhá na: Preparation takes ten minutes and happens on the big chart. You answer three questions: where the market is heading, where the target is and what would cancel the plan.
Než otevřeš malý graf, měj napsané tři v: Before you open the small chart, have three things written down: direction, target and what cancels the plan.
Bias není předpověď. Je to pracovní hypo: A bias is not a forecast. It is a working hypothesis you drop when price does not confirm it.
Cíl dne cena nemusí dosáhnout. Slouží ja: Price does not have to reach the day's target. It gives a direction, not a promise.
Denní graf míří nahoru a nad trhem je PD: The daily chart points up and PDH is above the market. In the morning an hourly candle closes below yesterday's low. What happens to the long plan?
Plán padá, dnes long nehledám: The plan is off, I do not look for a long today
Nic se nemění, bias platí dál: Nothing changes, the bias still holds
Přikoupím, cena je teď výhodnější: I buy more, the price is better now
Zavření pod úrovní, která měla plán zruš: A close below the level that was meant to cancel the plan is exactly the case you wrote it down for.
Svíčky jsou NQ. Čára pod nimi je ES ve s: The candles are NQ. The line below is ES at the same time, redrawn to the same scale so the shape can be compared. Both indices made a low at the same moment.
NQ teď udělal nižší low a vybral stopy p: NQ has now made a lower low and taken the stops under its low. ES did not take its low and stayed above it. The indices have parted ways. This is called an SMT divergence.
Samotné SMT není vstup. Je to potvrzení,: SMT alone is not an entry. It confirms that the sweep on NQ was probably not the start of a drop. You wait for a structure shift: a candle closes above the last high.
Dál už platí stejný postup jako vždy: ná: From here the usual routine applies: a return into the FVG, stop below the sweep low, target at liquidity. SMT only added one more reason.
SMT: když se NQ a ES rozejdou: SMT: when NQ and ES part ways
NQ a ES se většinu času hýbou spolu. Zaj: NQ and ES move together most of the time. It gets interesting when one of them does something the other does not.
SMT znamená, že jeden index vezme likvid: SMT means one index takes liquidity and the other does not. It is a confirmation, never the only reason to enter.
Rozdíl o pár ticků uprostřed range nic n: A difference of a few ticks in the middle of a range means nothing. SMT matters at important liquidity: PDH, PDL, session highs and lows.
SMT neříká, kdy vstoupit. Bez zlomu stru: SMT does not tell you when to enter. Without a structure shift it is only an observation.
NQ udělá vyšší high nad PDH, ES své PDH: NQ makes a higher high above PDH, ES does not get above its own PDH. What is it?
Jeden index vzal likviditu nad vrcholem,: One index took the liquidity above the high, the other did not. At a high it is a warning of a turn down, not a signal.
Jsi v longu z FVG na 110,5. Stop je pod: You are long from the FVG at 110.5. The stop is below the sweep low at 107.5. You risk 3 points, that is your 1R. From now on you manage the trade, not the entry.
Cena došla na 1R, tedy na 113,5. Častý p: Price has reached 1R, which is 113.5. A common approach is to take part of the position off here, half for example. Nobody can take that profit back and the rest can keep running.
U zbytku posuň stop na vstup. Cena se pa: Move the stop on the rest to the entry. Price then came back to 110.9 but did not reach the entry. The trade can no longer end in a loss.
Jedno pravidlo platí vždy: stop nikdy ne: One rule always holds: never move the stop further from the entry. When price goes against you, the plan stands. A wider stop means a loss bigger than 1R and statistics you cannot trust.
Zbytek dojel k cíli v likviditě na 119,5: The rest reached the target at liquidity at 119.5, which is 3R. Half at 1R and half at 3R adds up to 2R. Had the rest been stopped at the entry, you would keep 0.5R.
Řízení obchodu: stop, část zisku a zbyte: Trade management: stop, partial profit and the runner
Vstup je jen začátek. O výsledku často r: The entry is only the start. What you do afterwards often decides the result. And above all what you do not do.
Výstup naplánuj dřív, než vstoupíš: kde: Plan the exit before you enter: where you take part off, where the stop goes and where the target is.
Stop na vstupu hned po vstupu není opatr: A stop at the entry right after entering is not caution. A normal pullback throws you out of a trade that would otherwise have worked.
Částečný výběr snižuje průměrný zisk vým: Taking partials lowers the average profit in exchange for a smoother ride. Whether it pays off for you, only your journal will show.
Jsi v longu, cena jde proti tobě a blíží: You are long, price goes against you and nears the stop. What do you do?
Nic, stop je součást plánu: Nothing, the stop is part of the plan
Posunu stop níž, ať má obchod prostor: Move the stop lower to give the trade room
Přikoupím za lepší cenu: Buy more at a better price
Stop říká, kde tvůj nápad přestává plati: The stop says where your idea stops being valid. Moving it further means risking more than you planned.
První obchod je podle plánu: long, stop: The first trade follows the plan: long, stop below structure. The market turned and the stop was hit. A loss of 1R. That is a normal cost of trading, not a mistake.
Teď přichází nebezpečná chvíle. Chceš zt: Now comes the dangerous moment. You want the loss back at once, so you flip short without a setup. This is called revenge trading. The market comes back and you are at −2R.
Třetí pokus, tentokrát s dvojnásobnou po: A third attempt, this time with double size to get it all back at once. Another stop. One ordinary loss has become −4R in twenty minutes.
Trh mezitím nic nedělá, jen se převaluje: Meanwhile the market does nothing, it just drifts. It was not a bad day in the market. It was a day without a rule that would have stopped you.
Pravidlo, které to řeší: po dvou ztrátác: The rule that solves it: after two losses in a row you are done for the day, or you take at least a 30-minute break. The day would have ended at −2R. Add it to your pre-trade checklist.
Psychologie a pravidla: když chceš ztrát: Psychology and rules: when you want to win it back
Většinu účtů nezničí jeden špatný obchod: Most accounts are not ruined by one bad trade. They are ruined by what comes after it.
Ztráta je náklad. Problém začíná, když j: A loss is a cost. The trouble starts when you want it back right away.
Větší pozice po ztrátě ztrátu nevrátí ry: A bigger position after a loss does not bring it back faster. It only makes the next one bigger.
Pauza není slabost. Je to pravidlo jako: A break is not weakness. It is a rule like a stop-loss, only it protects you, not a single trade.
Máš za sebou dvě ztráty po sobě a vidíš: You have two losses in a row behind you and see another opportunity. What does the rule say?
Pro dnešek konec, nebo aspoň 30 minut pa: Done for the day, or at least a 30-minute break
Vzít ji, třetí pokus většinou vyjde: Take it, the third try usually works
Po ztrátách lidé často riskují víc, než: After losses people often risk more than they planned. The rule decides for you until you are calm again.
Některé dny trh nikam nejde. Svíčky se p: Some days the market goes nowhere. Candles overlap and bodies are small. Price takes the high and right after it the low of the same band. This is called chop.
Poznáš ho podle toho, co chybí. Žádný di: You know it by what is missing. No displacement, no FVG, no structure shift that holds. A sweep to both sides with no follow-through is a warning, not an opportunity.
Druhý typ špatného dne je den velké zprá: The second kind of bad day is a big news day. In the minute of the release (CPI, NFP, a Fed decision) the candle makes a large move in both directions. A stop can fill at a worse price than the one you set.
Po zprávě se trh chvíli hledá. Rozumné p: After the news the market takes a while to find itself. A sensible rule is not to trade around a red folder in the calendar, say 15 minutes before and 15 minutes after. The calendar is on the Tape home page.
Nejlepší obchod špatného dne je žádný. D: The best trade of a bad day is no trade. Write in the daily plan that you stayed out and why. In Tape a day with a plan and no trade counts as done.
Jak vypadá špatný den: chop a zprávy: What a bad day looks like: chop and news
Ne každý den se dá obchodovat. Poznat ho: Not every day can be traded. Spotting it in time and staying out is a skill courses hardly teach.
Když chybí displacement a struktura se n: When displacement is missing and structure does not hold, there is nothing to trade. Staying out is a decision too.
Chop nepoznáš předem. Poznáš ho podle pr: You cannot spot chop in advance. You see it in the market's first attempts that lead nowhere. That is why a cap on trades per day makes sense.
The move after news looks like an opportunity. Slippage and a wider spread make it a trade with a different risk than the one you calculated.
Od rána cena dvakrát vybrala high i low: Since the morning price has twice taken the high and the low of a narrow band and returned inside each time. No displacement. What now?
Zůstat venku a čekat na zlom s displacem: Stay out and wait for a shift with displacement
Obchodovat každý další dotek hrany: Trade every further touch of the edge
Vstoupit uprostřed pásma s větší pozicí: Enter mid-band with a bigger position
Bez displacementu nevznikne FVG ani plat: Without displacement there is no FVG and no valid structure shift. The model has nothing to form from.
